summary.text: Brian Strickland is the Republican nominee for Attorney General of Georgia. A trial attorney from Henry County, he is a state senator and chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Strickland graduated from Valdosta State University with a B.B.A. in economics in 2006 and earned a J.D. from the Florida Coastal School of Law in 2009.
A lawyer from McDonough, he served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 2013 to 2017 and was elected to the Georgia Senate in 2018.
In the Senate he represents District 42, and he chaired the Judiciary Committee in the 2021-22, 2023-24 and 2025-26 sessions.
He launched his campaign for attorney general in June 2025.
He won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary over Bill Cowsert and faces Democrat Tanya Miller in the November 3 general election.
